Postgraduate research
Postgraduate research study at St Andrews
Whatever your chosen discipline, your programme will put you in control, helping you make an impact on the latest research and innovation in your field.
Students who join our research programmes combine periods of intense research and independent study, and have the opportunity to:
network with top scholars at St Andrews and other universities
join a welcoming and internationally diverse community
get involved with as many societies, sports clubs, academic talks and events
develop their research skills
study in dedicated research study areas
access a range of libraries and state-of-the-art facilities
apply for scholarships and financial support for research-related travel
97% of research postgraduate students are either in employment or further study after graduation according to the Graduate Outcomes survey 2020-2021.
St Andrews research graduates move onto academic positions around the world and a range of professions outside of academia. Find out more about what you can do with your degree after you graduate.
